name: zimage_write_texture_directory
description: zImage::WriteTextureDirectory serializes texture-directory entries, including next-variant indices, and returns the written entry count.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this texture writer; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zImage/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: The frontier direct callees are zImage::TexDirEntryToIndex and zError::ReportOldNoOp.
The native smoke verifies texture-directory serialization count and entry-index behavior.
